articles.title: A Gap-Toothed Grin and a Sky Full of Jets: Prince Louis Steals the Show at Trooping the Colour
articles.summary: Eight-year-old Prince Louis chatted with his parents as Red Arrows jets roared over Buckingham Palace. Over 1,400 soldiers, 200 horses, and 400 musicians took part in the big parade.

articles.title: A Dad's Fight: Why Molly Russell's Father Says a Social Media Ban Is 'Deplorable'
articles.summary: Ian Russell, whose 14-year-old daughter Molly died after seeing harmful content online, says the UK prime minister is rushing a social media ban for kids under 16. He calls it 'deplorable' and warns it won't fix the real problem.

articles.title: Bye-Bye, Bronze Letters: Workers Remove Trump's Name from the Kennedy Center
articles.summary: In a pre-dawn operation, workers took down President Trump's name from the Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C. A judge said the name had to go because only Congress can rename the building.
